description: This file contains integration tests for Savings Account Transaction Data Tables in the Apache Fineract project. It defines test cases for creating, reading, updating, deleting data tables and entries related to savings account transactions, utilizing JUnit 5, REST-assured, and custom helper classes.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionDatatableIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that tests CRUD operations for data tables and entries related to savings account transactions in Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured specifications and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: testDatatableCreateReadUpdateDeleteForSavingsAccountTransaction
methods.description: Verifies creation, update, retrieval, and deletion of a data table for savings account transactions.

methods.name: testDatatableCreateReadUpdateDeleteEntryForSavingsAccountTransaction
methods.description: Creates a savings account, then adds, updates, retrieves, and deletes data table entries related to that account.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates and activates a savings account with daily posting interest configuration for testing.

methods.name: createSavingsProductDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates a savings product with interest calculation and posting periods set to daily.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets global configurations after each test.
